\begin{lexlean}{Studio.Gui.Usability}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.bool@1.2.0}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.nat@1.2.0}
\importmodule{Studio.Runtime}
\importmodule{Studio.User}
\importmodule{Studio.Gui.Accessibility}
\title{Natural number addition}
\begin{semanticmodule}
definition{
  name: actions,
  parameters: [lines : (List Bytes)],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match lines
    | List.nil => 0
    | List.cons line rest => (if (Studio.User::begins line 0x616374696f6e20) then ((actions rest) + 1) else (actions rest))),
  recursive_argument: lines,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: enabled,
  parameters: [lines : (List Bytes)],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match lines
    | List.nil => 0
    | List.cons line rest => (if ((Studio.User::begins line 0x616374696f6e20) && (Studio.User::begins (Studio.Gui.Accessibility::labelText line 0x616374696f6e20) 0x656e61626c6564)) then ((enabled rest) + 1) else (enabled rest))),
  recursive_argument: lines,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: firstView,
  parameters: [lines : (List Bytes)],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match lines
    | List.nil => 0x
    | List.cons line rest => (if (Studio.User::begins line 0x7669657720) then (Studio.Gui.Accessibility::labelText line 0x7669657720) else (firstView rest))),
  recursive_argument: lines,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: count,
  parameters: [value : Nat],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (Studio.Runtime::decimalFrom value 4 0x)
}

definition{
  name: effectiveness,
  parameters: [lines : (List Bytes), goal : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if ((enabled lines) =? 0) then (prim append (prim append (prim append 0x6566666563746976656e657373202849534f20393234312d31313a3230313820332e312e31322c20696e666572726564293a2074686520676f616c20 goal : Bytes) 0x206973206e6f74207265616368656420696e207468697320636f6e746578742c206e6f20616374696f6e206265696e6720656e61626c65643b20746865207669657720736179732077686174206974206e656564733a20 : Bytes) (firstView lines) : Bytes) else (prim append (prim append (prim append 0x6566666563746976656e657373202849534f20393234312d31313a3230313820332e312e31322c20696e666572726564293a2074686520676f616c20 goal : Bytes) 0x20697320726561636865642c20 : Bytes) (prim append (prim append (count (enabled lines)) 0x206f6620 : Bytes) (prim append (count (actions lines)) 0x20616374696f6e7320656e61626c6564 : Bytes) : Bytes) : Bytes)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: efficiency,
  parameters: [lines : (List Bytes)],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if ((enabled lines) =? 0) then 0x656666696369656e6379202849534f20393234312d31313a3230313820332e312e31332c20696e666572726564293a206e6f20726573756c74206973206163686965766564207965742c20736f206e6f207265736f75726365206973207370656e74206f6e206974 else 0x656666696369656e6379202849534f20393234312d31313a3230313820332e312e31332c20696e666572726564293a206f6e6520656e61626c656420616374696f6e2066726f6d2074686520766965772061636869657665732074686520726573756c742c2077697468206e6f20667572746865722073746570),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: satisfaction,
  parameters: [],
  result: Bytes,
  body: 
}

definition{
  name: measure,
  parameters: [tree : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (Studio.Runtime::split tree 10)
    | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374
    | List.cons opening rest => (if (not (Studio.User::begins opening 0x6a6f75726e657920)) then (prim append 0x726566757365643a2074686520766965772074726565206f70656e732077697468206e6f206a6f75726e65792c20736f206974206e616d6573206e6f20676f616c20746f206d6561737572652075736162696c69747920616761696e73743a20 opening : Bytes) else (prim append (prim append (effectiveness (cons opening rest) (Studio.Gui.Accessibility::labelName opening 0x6a6f75726e657920)) 0x0a : Bytes) (prim append (prim append (efficiency (cons opening rest)) 0x0a : Bytes) (satisfaction) : Bytes) : Bytes))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: request,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (Studio.Runtime::split value 9)
    | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374
    | List.cons mode rest => (if (Studio.Runtime::same mode 0x636865636b) then (measure (Studio.User::joinTabs rest)) else (if (Studio.Runtime::same mode 0x6a6f75726e6579) then (match rest
      | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374
      | List.cons journey more => (measure (Studio.User::view 0x68756d616e journey (Studio.User::joinTabs more)))) else 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: an_agent_and_a_person_get_the_same_measures,
  parameters: [journey : Bytes, rest : Bytes],
  statement: ((measure (Studio.User::view 0x6167656e74 journey rest)) = (measure (Studio.User::view 0x68756d616e journey rest))),
  proof: reflexivity{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
